name: Devansh Mehta
description: Devansh has worked as an investigative reporter and consultant to community media outlets in India, before entering Ethereum in 2021 to work on blockchain based impact certificates. He was selected for the 2023 Next Billion Fellowship by Ethereum Foundation and worked there from 2025-26. Devansh has completed a dual Master’s Degree in International Affairs and Investigative Journalism at Columbia University and is now focusing on prediction markets through his work at Seer.
